interfaces.name: mount_holes
interfaces.what: the four board mounting holes: Ø2.7000 x 0.8400 (the full board thickness) at (x, y) = (0.0050, -0.0050), (58.0050, -0.0050), (0.0050, -23.0050) and (58.0050, -23.0050) — a 58.0000 x 23.0000 mm rectangle, which is the Raspberry Pi HAT mounting pitch. Axis z, residual 0.0000 mm at 355.0 deg on all four. Frame origin is the pattern centroid on the board's top face (z 0.8400). Ø2.7000 is loose for M2 and is M2.5 free-fit; connection:threaded-m2 grades which.

interfaces.name: header_2x20
interfaces.what: the 40-way host header field: 40 x Ø1.0200 x 0.8400 plated holes on a 2.5400 mm grid, rows y -1.2700 and +1.2700, columns x 4.8700 to 53.1300 in 2.5400 steps (20 columns), plus 2 x Ø2.0000 x 0.8400 at (6.1400, 0.0000) and (51.8600, 0.0000) — the two mechanical anchors either end of the header. Residual 0.0000 mm at 355.0 deg throughout. Frame origin is the field centre on the board's bottom face. `accepts` is EMPTY because a through-hole solder joint is connection:solder-tht, which is NOT on this shelf — naming it would dangle. The electrical side of this header lives in ELECTRONICS-DATASHEET.html, not here.

interfaces.name: peripheral_connectors
interfaces.what: 14 x Ø0.9500 x 0.8400 plated holes in two blocks on a 2.5000 mm grid: block A, x 43.8500 and 48.6500 (4.8000 mm apart) x y -23.0000, -20.5000, -18.0000, -15.5000 (8 holes); block B, x 53.5000 and 58.3000 x y -17.4500, -14.9500, -12.4500 (6 holes). Residual 0.0000 mm at 355.0 deg. Frame origin is the centroid of the fourteen on the board's bottom face. WHICH CONNECTORS THESE ARE IS CANNOT DETERMINE from geometry: a 2.5000 mm pitch with a 4.8000 mm row gap fits several families, and no silkscreen or refdes exists in a mesh. What settles it: a photograph of the real Robot HAT, or the board file the PCB lane is producing (electronics/robot-hat/).
